text: The system separates facts interpretations hypotheses forecasts and decisions. Evidence and source provenance are verified through testing and validation.
Risk engine contains models on portfolio construction quantitative finance structured finance risk and real options. Decision architectures require rigorous validation.
EDNA describes knowledge architecture retrieval provenance ontology and evidence grounded systems. Multi hop retrieval pipeline evaluates citation lineage.
Hobbly describes marketplace booking CRM payment flows and transactional state machines. Escrow releases and dispute arbitration are deterministic.
ARXIS concerns architecture documentation decisions requirements traceability and collaboration. Dependency graphs govern multidisciplinary engineering changes.
ARXA concerns industrial data supply chain optimization predictive maintenance scenarios and real options. Sensor telemetry forecasts remaining useful life.
